Dr. Denis Anikiev delivered an invited presentation to the Saudi Aramco Geophysical Imaging Department Innovation Team Seminar Series titled *From Acquisition to Insight: AI-Driven Seismic Imaging and Microseismic Workflows*.

The seminar connected recent advances in seismic imaging and microseismic monitoring with diffusion models, neural operators, deep learning, and physics-informed methods. The examples illustrated how these approaches can support subsurface characterization from data acquisition through interpretation.

The discussion generated interest in potential collaboration between CPG and Saudi Aramco on computational geophysics, seismic imaging, and AI-enabled geophysical workflows.
